using JSON3
function sh(cmd)
    try
        return read(pipeline(ignorestatus(`bash -lc $cmd`); stderr = stdout), String)
    catch e
        return "ERR " * sprint(showerror, e)
    end
end
res = Dict{String,Any}()
res["which"] = sh("which -a python python3; echo PATH=\$PATH")
res["torch"] = sh("python3 -c 'import torch;print(torch.__version__, torch.cuda.is_available(), torch.version.cuda)' 2>&1 | tail -3")
res["jax"] = sh("python3 -c 'import jax;print(jax.__version__, jax.devices())' 2>&1 | tail -3")
res["pip"] = sh("pip list 2>/dev/null | grep -i -E 'torch|jax|numpy|tensorflow|cupy|triton' ")
res["nvsmi"] = sh("nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total,memory.used --format=csv")
res["module"] = sh("module list 2>&1 | head -20; ls ~ 2>&1 | head -30; pwd; echo \$HOME")
res["venv"] = sh("ls -d ~/*venv* ~/.venv* /opt/*venv* /opt/conda* 2>&1 | head")
